name: Lifting scheme for 1/2 subdivision
definition: A specific application of the lifting scheme for 1/2 subdivision, distinguishing between hypervolume, volume, face, and edge cases based on the subdivision step. It automatically handles boundary cases.
summary: This method applies the lifting scheme to linear B-spline wavelet decomposition for 1/2 subdivision, automatically managing boundary conditions across hypervolume, volume, face, and edge cases.
